curriculum.title: Capstone
points: Participants will design a comprehensive digital and AI transformation initiative for a realistic enterprise scenario. They will define a strategic vision, assess organizational readiness, architect an operating model, and develop a roadmap integrating AI, data, platforms, and governance. The project culminates in a boardroom-style presentation showcasing value realization, KPIs, and stakeholder alignment—demonstrating each participant’s capability to lead large-scale innovation as a Chief Digital and AI Officer.

content.title: Is prior experience in Digital and AI Leadership Program required for program enrollment?
content: This program is specifically crafted for seasoned professionals looking to advance their careers and expand their sectoral knowledge. It is intended for individuals with substantial industry experience.

content.title: How many projects can I anticipate working on?
content: In the Chief Digital & AI Officer Program, you’ll complete core modules and select elective specializations, while working on capstone projects to enhance your strategic thinking and practical expertise in real-world digital and AI transformation challenges.

content.title: How much time does one need to spend?
content: Ideally, 30 minutes of preparation time is recommended each day, but students can allocate time according to their own schedules. They can choose to practice, read, or watch videos. Additionally, students must attend live classes on weekends. The schedule for these classes will be shared in advance.

content.title: What is the duration of the program?
content: The duration of the program is 11 months.

content.title: How is the IIM Visakhapatnam's PG Certificate Program in Chief Digital & AI Officer Program different?
content: ### Three things that make this program world class :

- **Advanced Pedagogical Approach:** IIM Visakhapatnam's advanced pedagogical approach, supported by its rank of 26th by NIRF, ensures a cutting-edge, innovative, and effective learning experience. This method fosters deep understanding and real-world application of  Chief Digital & AI Officer concepts.

- **Bridging Ideas to Industry:** IIM Visakhapatnam bridges academic ideas to real-world industry applications through a structured framework, fostering practical learning and career readiness. This ensures that students are not only theoretically knowledgeable but also equipped to tackle contemporary business challenges effectively.
- **Accredian Career Center:** Aligned with our mission to cultivate the leaders of tomorrow, the Accredian Career Center empowers you to confidently launch your career.

content.title: Tell me more about Career Assistance?
content: You will have access to Accredian Career Support module. This module includes comprehensive career development sessions aimed at enhancing your job profile and helping you excel in your interviews.
